title: Wide Tables & One-Big-Table Design
description: Master the recurring practitioner choice between a normalised star schema and a wide one-big-table (OBT) model. Learn when denormalisation pays for itself, where it bites, and how BI tools and ML feature pipelines change the trade-off.
outcomes: You'll decide when an OBT outperforms a star schema, name the cost of denormalisation in update-heavy systems, design wide-table models for BI and ML feature stores, and recognise the scalability limits at which OBTs break down.
